mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description, r.create_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ur.user_id, r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.description, r.create_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id IN
#{userId}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.real_name, u.user_no, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.status, u.create_time FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY u.id DESC
